# edododraw

> A 100% code/syntax-to-diagram engine with the Excalidraw hand-drawn aesthetic, magic-move camera, scriptable + real-time annotations, animated arrows, and first-class Mermaid import.

Everything an LLM needs in ONE file: https://vivmagarwal.github.io/edododraw/llms-full.txt

- [Camera & timeline](https://vivmagarwal.github.io/edododraw/#/docs/camera-timeline)
- [Annotations](https://vivmagarwal.github.io/edododraw/#/docs/annotations)

- [Architecture](https://vivmagarwal.github.io/edododraw/#/docs/architecture)

## Visualizations (87 templates × 9 style presets)
All usable as `viz <name> { item "Label" ... }`; full reference with runnable examples in llms-full.txt:
clouds, converge, diverge, head-thoughts, key-ideas, list, personas, quote, business-model-canvas, ecosystem, flywheel, funnel, hex-cluster, okr, pestel, porters, swot, value-chain, domino, fishbone, impact, root-causes, balance, decision, decision-tree, podium, pricing-tiers, pros-and-cons, quadrant, relationship, spectrum, table, venn, versus, area, bar, bar-horizontal, bullet-chart, drop-off, dumbbell-horizontal, dumbbell-vertical, gauge, heatmap, line, pie, radar, sankey, slope-chart, stacked-bar, stacked-bar-horizontal, waterfall, bullseye, pyramid, mindmap, mindmap-horizontal, mindmap-left, mindmap-right, mindmap-vertical, iceberg, bridge, challenges, problem-solution, transformation, cycle, flowchart, gantt, journey, kanban, sequence, stairs, swimlane-flow, milestone-path, roadmap-lanes, timeline, bottleneck, dialogue, hole, lens, lighthouse, magnet, performance, pillar, prism, race, trend, tug-of-war, vision
